name_zh: 利爪横扫 — 玛格玛洛斯的开场一击
grid: 5 cols x 228 px square cells, 10 frames, see art/spells.js SHEET
colour_en: hot crimson 0xff3a5a with a 0xffd9e2 core, to agree with the drawn gashes, the shout and the wave the same beat already throws
colour_zh: 深红 0xff3a5a，核心 0xffd9e2，与同一拍已有的手绘爪痕、喊话和冲击波保持一致
prompt_en: painted 3D mobile-RPG game VFX, semi-realistic, high contrast, a bright white-hot core with saturated colour thrown off it, no flat cartoon shading. Three parallel claw slashes tear diagonally across the frame from the upper right down to the lower left, one after another rather than all at once, about four hundredths of a second apart, so it reads as one hand going through rather than three lines laid on the screen. Each slash opens from nothing and rips along its own length: a tapered gash, widest about a third of the way along and coming to a fine point at both ends, its edges ragged and torn with small hooks and splinters coming off them, never a smooth stripe, never a rounded bar, never a straight line. The middle slash is the longest and cuts the deepest, the two outside it are shorter and sit parallel to it and evenly spaced. Each gash is a hot crimson red wound with a thin white-hot core burning down the middle of its length, throwing small sparks and flecks of molten light off its torn edges, and a faint red heat glow sits behind all three as if the air itself had been opened. They flare to their brightest the instant they finish opening, hold for a moment, then burn down and fade from the tips inward until the frame is completely black again. It is one swipe, and it is finished well before the clip ends. The effect is isolated on a pure flat black background, nothing else in frame: no floor, no room, no landscape, no wall, no rock, no creature, no monster, no claws, no hand, no arm, no character, no smoke, no dust, no haze, no atmospheric glow. Nothing in the frame is lit except the slashes themselves. The three slashes stay centred and fill the frame corner to corner and are never cropped by the edges. Square frame. Single continuous shot, one fixed locked-off camera, no cuts, no shot changes, no camera movement, no zoom, no push in, no pan, no tilt, no orbit, no shake, no parallax. No lens flare, no bloom washing over the whole frame, no vignette, no depth of field, no film grain, no motion blur smear. Clean high-contrast game VFX plate, bright light on black, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no UI.
prompt_zh: 手绘风格的 3D 手游 RPG 特效，半写实，高对比，炽白的核心向外抛出饱和的颜色，不要扁平的卡通着色。三道平行的爪痕沿对角线撕开画面，从右上方划向左下方，不是同时出现，而是一道接一道，相隔约四十毫秒，因此读起来是一只手抓过去，而不是三条线摆在屏幕上。每一道都从无到有地裂开，并沿着自身的长度撕开：一道两头收尖的伤口，大约在三分之一处最宽，两端都收成细尖，边缘粗糙撕裂、带着细小的倒钩与毛刺，绝不是光滑的条带，绝不是圆角的长条，绝不是笔直的直线。中间那道最长、最深，两侧的两道略短，与它平行且间距均匀。每一道都是炽热的深红色伤口，正中有一条细而炽白的核心在燃烧，撕裂的边缘不断抛出细小的火星和熔融光点；三道的背后还有一层淡淡的红色热辉，仿佛空气本身被撕开。它们在裂开完成的瞬间亮到最强，短暂停留，然后从尖端向内燃尽、淡去，直到画面重新变成全黑。这只是一次挥爪，并且在片子结束之前很早就已经完成。特效单独出现在纯正的全黑背景上，画面里没有别的东西：没有地面、没有房间、没有风景、没有墙壁、没有岩石、没有生物、没有怪物、没有爪子、没有手、没有手臂、没有角色，没有烟雾、没有尘土、没有雾气、没有大气辉光。画面中除了爪痕本身，没有任何被照亮的东西。三道爪痕始终居中，从一角铺到另一角，绝不被画面边缘裁切。方形画幅。单镜头一镜到底，固定机位，无剪辑、无场景切换、无镜头运动、无变焦、无推近、无横摇、无俯仰、无环绕、无抖动、无视差。无镜头光晕，无覆盖整个画面的泛光，无暗角，无景深虚化，无胶片颗粒，无运动模糊拖影。干净的高对比游戏特效素材，黑底亮光，无文字、无字母、无数字、无水印、无标志、无 UI。
